notFound.title: Transaction not found
notFound.clockSkew: The transaction was not found near the time in its ID; the agent clock may have been off. Open it from a transaction list, or add its start time to the link as ts.
notFound.hinted: No transaction with this ID was found at the given start time. It may be outside the retention period, or the link may be wrong.
notFound.other: The transaction was not found. It may be outside the retention period, or the link may be wrong.
notFound.invalidId: This is not a transaction ID. Transaction IDs are decimal numbers of up to 20 digits.

actions.label: Transaction actions
actions.callerNotFound: The calling application is known, but its transaction was not found within the hour before this one.
actions.logsUnavailable: No log link is configured. An administrator can set a log search link template.

adjacent.noList: Previous and next need the list this transaction was opened from. Open it from the $t(common:term.xlog) list.
adjacent.notXlog: Previous and next are available when the transaction is opened from the $t(common:term.xlog) list.
adjacent.listEmpty: The list this transaction was opened from has no transactions.
adjacent.notInList: This transaction is not in the first 1,000 rows of the list it was opened from.
adjacent.listError: The list could not be loaded, so previous and next are not available.
adjacent.first: This is the first transaction of the list.
adjacent.last: This is the last transaction of the loaded list.

profile.sampledOut: Profile not captured (sampling policy): the agent recorded the transaction but not its steps.
profile.lost: Profile lost (dropped): steps were captured but did not arrive before the ingest allowance ended.
profile.retentionExceeded: The profile is older than the profile retention period and is no longer stored.
profile.stepsPending: The transaction ended moments ago; its steps may still arrive.
profile.stepTruncated: Partial profile: the agent stopped recording steps at its step limit ({{shown}} shown, {{total}} happened). Later steps are summarized.
profile.summarized: Summary mode: the agent folded later steps of the same kind into summary steps.

summary.title: Summary
summary.notMeasuredNote: The agent could not measure this (for example on a virtual thread).
summary.callerNone: Not called by another instrumented application.
summary.callerUnknown: Joined an incoming trace, but the calling application is not known.
summary.uninstrumentedNote: 20% or more of the response time is outside the recorded steps.
summary.uninstrumentedServerDiffers: Timeline value; it differs from the server value (overlapping, out-of-range or parentless steps). Server:

baseline.scope_other: {{countText}} requests of the same service within 30 minutes
baseline.percentileUnknown: This request's percentile is not known

baseline.noSample: No normal request of this service is available to compare with.
baseline.sampleSameInstance: The normal request ran on the same instance.

compare.noProfile: No profile steps were recorded for this request.
compare.notFound: The request to compare with was not found. It may be outside the retention period.
